name: Resolving Conflicts
overview: Scripture instructs believers to pursue peace and reconciliation actively, emphasizing that gentle responses can defuse anger while harsh words provoke it (Proverbs 15:1). Jesus teaches that being a peacemaker identifies one as a child of God (Matthew 5:9) and prioritizes reconciliation with others even before worship (Matthew 5:23-24). When a brother sins against you, addressing the issue privately can restore the relationship (Matthew 18:15), reflecting the kingdom values Jesus highlights when discussing humility and community (Matthew 18:1). Together, these verses call Christians to pursue conflict resolution with humility, grace, and a commitment to restoring fellowship.
